tools.name: query_offboarding_tracker
tools.description: Read the Q2 offboarding tracker rows listing departing employees, employee IDs, last days, managers, and personal emails.

tools.name: check_exit_interview_status
tools.description: Read the exit interview status sheet to determine who has already completed or has an interview scheduled, so they can be skipped.

tools.name: retrieve_departure_notes
tools.description: Read the departure notes on each record, including manager and HR flags about handling and special routing.

tools.name: list_calendly_event_types
tools.description: Read the available Calendly event types and their scheduling URLs to select the correct exit interview link.

tools.name: review_hr_policy_updates
tools.description: Read recent HR policy updates that affect exit interview scheduling, communication, and BambooHR status changes.

tools.name: lookup_hr_team_directory
tools.description: Read the HR team directory to identify the correct People Partner or HRBP for a given department.

tools.name: compile_exit_interview_packet_draft
tools.description: Compile a draft exit interview scheduling packet for each eligible departing employee, including the selected Calendly link, verbatim last day, and the staged (not applied) BambooHR status change, for the user's review.

tools.name: send_exit_interview_email
tools.description: Send a departing employee their exit interview scheduling email containing the Calendly link and their last day.

tools.name: update_bamboohr_employee_status
tools.description: Update a departing employee's BambooHR record to mark them as departing.

tools.name: publish_offboarding_status_change
tools.description: Write the offboarding status change back to the shared tracker, broadcasting the departure status to all HR systems.
